hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE 'design/design\.md$' && { echo 'design/design.md is authoritative; ask the user before editing it.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -q '\.rs$' && cargo fmt || true

test -f Cargo.toml || exit 0; test -n "$(git status --porcelain -- '*.rs' Cargo.toml Cargo.lock)" || exit 0; cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test || exit 2
test -n "$(git status --porcelain -- '*.md' docs scripts .github src)" || exit 0; ./scripts/lint-docs || exit 2
